title: Custom metadata labels with Claude models on Vertex AI
body:
Google Cloud Vertex AI enables us to annotate custom metadata labels. We can utilize the labels to analyze cost. 
If Claude-code supports this feature, we can granularly analyze cost of Claude models on Google Cloud. Specifically,  it would be great to add the user account or the Google Cloud service account to identify who call Claude models on Vertex AI with claude-code.

https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/multimodal/add-labels-to-api-calls
author: yu-iskw

top_comments.body:
Please consider adding this feature. It would be useful for us to track our Claude Code usage per agent, in GCP cost dashboard instead of setting up open telemetry for this usecase.

A simple solution like  the one you have for oltp  would help resolve my require

existing feature:
```export OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES="department=engineering,team.id=platform_team"```
